findings.trigger: Last item is skipped because reviewed content is missing/stale/ambiguous; finishing the session fails
findings.expected: User can explicitly retry the exact pending terminal command while skip produces no answer evidence
findings.actual: Both screens render completionRetryRequired action only inside question != null branch. Skipped last item keeps question null; controller transitions to completionRetryRequired, disabling advance and locking PopScope without any visible retry action
findings.proposedRegression: Widget tests for definition and cloze with last skipped item and finish failing once: exact retry visible and succeeds, no answer evidence inserted, stable captured terminal intent and no duplicate completion

findings.expected: Every already-composed manager is disposed before database closes, preserving original initialization failure
findings.actual: offlineContent.dispose is registered only after reconcile, catalog recovery and device-model construction; failed reconcile skips ownership registration
findings.proposedRegression: Injected OfflineContentManager whose reconcile throws; assert dispose exactly once and original error preserved, including throwing cleanup

findings.trigger: Guest entry consent await permits duplicate taps; guest.start or consent persistence throws
findings.expected: Single admitted entry operation with recoverable visible failure and busy cleared
findings.actual: busy starts after first await; guest path lacks catch/finally
findings.proposedRegression: Deferred consent/guest fake, rapid taps and throwing result; inspect canonical provider error contract before changing

findings.trigger: Closed-state request remains in flight while newer failures open circuit; old request then succeeds
findings.expected: Confirm intended generation semantics before treating stale completion as fresh half-open health probe
findings.actual: Every success calls _onSuccess without generation/state ownership
findings.proposedRegression: Controlled overlapping futures and provider caller analysis

findings.trigger: Legacy source has a small main file but large live WAL rows, or one oversized row
findings.expected: Enforce bounded snapshot allocation before loading payload rows while preserving read-only WAL semantics
findings.actual: Main-file size checked, then source.select materializes up to100001 rows before encoded maxBytes check
findings.proposedRegression: Synthetic read-only WAL fixture over declared budget; ensure rejection without mutating source/destination and bound preflight reads

findings.trigger: Wall clock moves backward during a generic quiz; captured finish or abandon time precedes stored session start
findings.expected: Canonical terminal mutation preserves a valid temporal interval; history remains readable and original captured intent is handled explicitly
findings.actual: finishSession and abandonSession validate UTC but do not compare terminal with startedAtUtcMs; history entry constructor rejects endedAtUtc before startedAtUtc
findings.proposedRegression: Controlled clock generic session close before start, then read history; verify atomic rejection or explicitly defined clock policy without hiding invalid timestamps

findings.trigger: Active owner changes between generic startQuiz owner lookup/scheduling and startSession insertion
findings.expected: Generic session start either admits the still-active owner atomically or reports owner drift
findings.actual: Generic _insertLearningSession performs insertOrIgnore with an owner FK but no active-owner transaction check; exact pinned/Pair starts have a stronger check. QuizScreen uses generic startQuiz in its ordinary path
findings.proposedRegression: Deferred start boundary with real Drift owner switch; inspect lifecycle initializeSession before asserting user-visible effect. Also confirm collision replay behavior of insertOrIgnore
